## Document: /docs/cookbook/document-summarizer/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Cookbook Blueprint
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Document Summarizer</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Fine-tune a long-context language model to distill complex technical reports and whitepapers into standardized, executive-ready key findings.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>What You'll Build</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>A localized Qwen2.5-3B or 7B model tuned for structured 8K+ context processing.</li>
    <li>Memory-optimized training utilizing FlashAttention-2 and gradient checkpointing on 12GB–16GB VRAM GPUs.</li>
    <li>Evaluation suites that verify factual coverage, bullet-count constraints, and thesis statement clarity.</li>
    <li>Instant local serving via Ollama for seamless internal document pipeline integration.</li>
  </ul>

  <h2>Step 1: Prepare Long-Form Training Data</h2>
  
  <p>Format training documents into structured prompt/response JSONL conversation pairs:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-cyan-300 leading-relaxed">
cat &gt; doc_summaries.jsonl &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
{`{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are an executive intelligence summarizer. Given a lengthy technical document, produce a structured executive brief with: 1) Thesis statement, 2) Key technical takeaways (3-5 bullets), and 3) Actionable recommendation."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize the database latency report: During Q3, our primary PostgreSQL cluster experienced periodic latency spikes reaching 1,850ms during peak batch windows..."}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "**Thesis**: Database latency spikes and webhook cascading failures stem from unindexed ledger queries and lack of application-level connection pooling.\n\n**Key Findings**:\n- Latency spikes peaked at 1,850ms during batch processing windows.\n- Unindexed queries exhausted the 800-connection database ceiling.\n- Read replicas successfully offloaded analytics traffic.\n\n**Recommendation**: Deploy PgBouncer connection pooling and add foreign key migration indexes."}]}`}
EOF
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 2: Scaffolding & moro.yaml Long-Context Setup</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro init doc-summarizer --template document-summarizer
cd doc-summarizer
cp ../doc_summaries.jsonl data/raw/
  </pre>

  <p>In <code>moro.yaml</code>, expand the maximum sequence length and enable gradient checkpointing:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
name: "doc-summarizer"
version: "1.0.0"

dataset:
  source: ./data/raw/doc_summaries.jsonl
  format: jsonl
  max_seq_length: 8192                # Extended 8K context window

model:
  base: "Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct"
  quantization: "nf4"

training:
  learning_rate: 2.0e-4
  micro_batch_size: 1
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 16
  gradient_checkpointing: true        # Saves up to 60% activation memory
  auto_heal: true
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 3: VRAM Hardware Recipe & Training</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-purple-300">
# 1. Compile long-form data
moro data build

# 2. Check pre-flight VRAM budget at 8192 sequence length
moro recipe suggest --model 3b --seq 8192

# 3. Start training run
moro train
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 4: Executive Brief Evaluation Suite</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-orange-300">
cat &gt; eval/summary_eval.yaml &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
name: "summary-quality-suite"
tests:
  - id: "test_thesis_presence"
    prompt: "Summarize: [Technical Report Excerpt]"
    expected_keywords: ["**Thesis**:", "**Key Findings**:", "**Recommendation**:"]
EOF

moro eval run --checkpoint ./runs/best/ --suite eval/summary_eval.yaml
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 5: Deploy to Ollama with Custom Context Ceiling</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-teal-300">
moro release export --run-id best --version v1.0.0 --quant Q4_K_M
moro release deploy --target ollama --version v1.0.0 --name doc-summarizer
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/code-assistant/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Code Assistant
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/medical-qa/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Medical Q&A System</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>

## Document: /docs/cookbook/json-extractor/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Cookbook Blueprint
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Structured JSON Extractor</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Train a compact local model to parse invoices, receipts, and contract text into strict, deterministic JSON payloads.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>The Objective</h2>
  <p>
    Extract structured entity fields from arbitrary unstructured enterprise strings:
  </p>

  <div class="not-prose my-6 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs font-mono">
    <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-dark-950 border border-dark-800">
      <span class="text-gray-400 font-bold block mb-2">Unstructured Input</span>
      <p class="text-gray-300 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
{`"Invoice #INV-9821 from Apex Logistics Corp for $1,450.00 due on 2026-10-15. Terms net-30."`}
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-dark-950 border border-dark-800">
      <span class="text-cyan-400 font-bold block mb-2">Extracted JSON Payload</span>
      <pre class="text-cyan-300 leading-relaxed">
{`{
  "invoice_number": "INV-9821",
  "vendor": "Apex Logistics Corp",
  "amount": 1450.00,
  "currency": "USD",
  "due_date": "2026-10-15"
}`}
      </pre>
    </div>
  </div>

  <h2>Training Data Formulation</h2>
  
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300 leading-relaxed">
cat &gt; data/raw/invoices.jsonl &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
{`{"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Extract JSON from: Invoice #12345 from Acme Corp for $500 due on 2024-03-15"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "{\\"invoice_number\\": \\"12345\\", \\"vendor\\": \\"Acme Corp\\", \\"amount\\": 500, \\"due_date\\": \\"2024-03-15\\"}"}]}`}
{`{"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Extract JSON from: PO-9876 from Widget Inc for $1,250 due 2024-04-01"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "{\\"invoice_number\\": \\"PO-9876\\", \\"vendor\\": \\"Widget Inc\\", \\"amount\\": 1250, \\"due_date\\": \\"2024-04-01\\"}"}]}`}
EOF
  </pre>

  <h2>Evaluation Suite with JSON Schema Validation</h2>
  <p>Enforce 100% deterministic schema compliance using MoroAI's evaluation harness:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-orange-300 leading-relaxed">
name: "invoice-json-eval"
tests:
  - id: "test_invoice_schema"
    prompt: "Extract JSON from: Invoice #555 from Test Co for $99 due 2026-11-01"
    expected_schema:
      type: "object"
      required: ["invoice_number", "vendor", "amount", "due_date"]
      properties:
        invoice_number:
          type: "string"
        vendor:
          type: "string"
        amount:
          type: "number"
        due_date:
          type: "string"
  </pre>

  <h2>Production Python Client</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300 leading-relaxed">
{`import json
import httpx

def extract_invoice_json(document_text: str) -> dict:
    """Query fine-tuned local extractor via Ollama."""
    response = httpx.post(
        "http://localhost:11434/api/generate",
        json={
            "model": "json-extractor:v1.0.0",
            "prompt": f"Extract JSON from: {document_text}",
            "stream": False,
            "format": "json"
        },
        timeout=15.0
    )
    raw_completion = response.json()["response"]
    return json.loads(raw_completion)

# Example invocation:
data = extract_invoice_json("Bill #4489 from CloudHost for $89.50 due 2026-10-31")
print("Structured Data:\\n", data)
print("Vendor:", data["vendor"])`}
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/support-bot/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Support Bot Recipe
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/code-assistant/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">

## Document: /docs/cookbook/legal-analyzer/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Cookbook Blueprint
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Legal Contract Analyzer</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Train a private legal extraction model to parse indemnification clauses, liability caps, and governing jurisdiction with strict verbatim quotation constraints.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>What You'll Build</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>A localized Qwen2.5 or Llama-3.2 model fine-tuned on commercial agreements, NDAs, and Master Services Agreements (MSAs).</li>
    <li>Zero-hallucination extraction: every output value is constrained to be an exact verbatim substring of the input contract text.</li>
    <li>100% attorney-client privileged local execution: training weights, source contracts, and extracted outputs never touch external cloud APIs.</li>
  </ul>

  <h2>Step 1: Prepare Contract Training Data</h2>
  
  <p>Format training contracts into prompt/response JSONL with structured JSON extraction:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-cyan-300 leading-relaxed">
cat &gt; contracts_data.jsonl &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
{`{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a legal contract analysis engine. Extract clauses strictly as JSON without commentary. Every extracted value must be an exact verbatim substring from the source contract."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Extract indemnification, liability cap, and governing law:\n\nSection 14. Indemnification. Service Provider agrees to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer from any gross negligence. Section 15. Liability. Total liability shall not exceed total fees paid in the prior 12 months. Section 19. Forum. Governed by the laws of Delaware."}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "{\"indemnification\": \"defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer from any gross negligence\", \"liability_cap\": \"not exceed total fees paid in the prior 12 months\", \"governing_law\": \"laws of Delaware\"}"}]}`}
EOF
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 2: Scaffolding & Configuration</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro init legal-reviewer --template legal-analyzer
cd legal-reviewer
cp ../contracts_data.jsonl data/raw/
  </pre>

  <p>In <code>moro.yaml</code>, enforce strict PII scrubbing and conservative token cleaning:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
name: "legal-reviewer"
version: "1.0.0"

dataset:
  source: ./data/raw/contracts_data.jsonl
  format: jsonl
  pii_scan: true                      # Strips real client names, SSNs, and banking details
  mi_guard_threshold: 0.88            # Protects rare statutory citations (e.g. Del. C. § 102(b)(7))

model:
  base: "Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"
  quantization: "nf4"

training:
  learning_rate: 1.8e-4
  micro_batch_size: 1
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 16
  gradient_checkpointing: true
  auto_heal: true
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 3: Compile & Train</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-purple-300">
moro data build
moro train
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 4: Citation & Substring Grounding Evaluation</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-orange-300">
cat &gt; eval/legal_eval.yaml &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
name: "legal-grounding-suite"
tests:
  - id: "test_nda_extraction"
    prompt: "Extract clauses from: [Sample NDA Excerpt]"
    expected_keywords: ["indemnify", "liability", "Delaware"]
EOF

moro eval run --checkpoint ./runs/best/ --suite eval/legal_eval.yaml
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 5: Local Air-Gapped Deployment</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-teal-300">
moro release export --run-id best --version v1.0.0 --quant Q4_K_M
moro release deploy --target ollama --version v1.0.0 --name legal-reviewer
  </pre>

  <h2>Privilege & Governance Guarantees</h2>
  <div class="not-prose my-6 rounded-2xl border border-dark-800 bg-dark-900/60 p-5 space-y-3 text-sm text-gray-300 font-sans">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <CheckCircle2 class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
      <span>100% on-premise execution preserves Attorney-Client Privilege.</span>
    </div>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <CheckCircle2 class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
      <span>Zero telemetry egress or external logging verified by <code>moro doctor --privacy</code>.</span>
    </div>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/cookbook/medical-qa/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Cookbook Blueprint
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Medical Q&A System</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Train clinically-grounded Q&A models on private guidelines, drug monographs, and de-identified notes with guaranteed on-premise HIPAA isolation.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>What You'll Build</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>A localized Qwen2.5-7B or Llama-3.2-3B clinical assistant that runs 100% on-premise behind your hospital firewall.</li>
    <li>Information-theoretic MI Guard protection that mathematically shields rare medical terms, contraindications, and dosages from being pruned during deduplication.</li>
    <li>A deterministic evaluation harness with asymmetric penalties against hallucinated dosages, ungrounded lab thresholds, and fabricated citations.</li>
    <li>A zero-latency Ollama local inference service queryable via Python or EHR REST hooks.</li>
  </ul>

  <h2>Step 1: Prepare Training Data</h2>
  
  <p>Format your clinical references and protocol guidelines into multi-turn JSONL conversation pairs:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-cyan-300 leading-relaxed">
cat &gt; clinical_corpus.jsonl &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
{`{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a clinical decision support assistant. Provide grounded medical guidelines, dosages, contraindications, and citations without hallucinating."}, {"role": "user", "content": "What are the contraindications for metformin in renal impairment?"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Per ADA Standards of Care (2025):\n1. Metformin is contraindicated if estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) < 30 mL/min/1.73 m².\n2. Initiation is not recommended with eGFR 30–44 mL/min/1.73 m².\n3. If eGFR falls between 30–44 mL/min/1.73 m² during therapy, evaluate risks vs benefits and cap maximum daily dose at 1000 mg.\n4. Monitor renal function every 3 months for eGFR < 60 mL/min/1.73 m²."}]}`}
{`{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a clinical decision support assistant. Provide grounded medical guidelines, dosages, contraindications, and citations without hallucinating."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Can ACE inhibitors and ARBs be co-administered in refractory diabetic nephropathy to reduce proteinuria?"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Dual renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) blockade combining an ACE inhibitor and an ARB is contraindicated. Large clinical trials (ONTARGET and NEPHRON-D) established that dual blockade fails to improve cardiovascular or renal mortality while substantially increasing risks of hyperkalemia, acute kidney injury (AKI), and hypotension."}]}`}
EOF
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 2: Initialize Project & Configure moro.yaml</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro init clinical-assistant --template medical-qa
cd clinical-assistant
cp ../clinical_corpus.jsonl data/raw/
  </pre>

  <p>Set a high PPMI threshold in <code>moro.yaml</code> to protect rare pharmacological terminology:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
name: "clinical-assistant"
version: "1.0.0"

dataset:
  source: ./data/raw/clinical_corpus.jsonl
  format: jsonl
  pii_scan: true                      # Mandatory HIPAA pre-flight scanner
  mi_guard_threshold: 0.82            # Preserves rare medical outlier terms
  dedup_threshold: 0.92

model:
  base: "Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"
  quantization: "nf4"

training:
  learning_rate: 1.5e-4
  micro_batch_size: 1
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 16
  gradient_checkpointing: true
  auto_heal: true                     # Autonomous OOM recovery
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 3: Compile Data & Train</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-purple-300">
# 1. Compile with MI Guard protection
moro data build

# 2. Verify VRAM on your GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 12GB or RTX 4070 16GB)
moro recipe suggest --model 7b --quant nf4

# 3. Execute self-healing training run
moro train
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 4: Hallucination-Strict Evaluation Suite</h2>
  <p>Create an evaluation harness that penalizes hallucinated dosages and made-up citations:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-orange-300">
cat &gt; eval/clinical_safety.yaml &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
name: "clinical-safety-suite"
tests:
  - id: "test_metformin_egfr"
    prompt: "Can I prescribe metformin to a patient with eGFR of 24 mL/min?"
    expected_keywords: ["contraindicated", "below 30"]
    forbidden_terms: ["safe to proceed", "start standard dose"]
  - id: "test_dual_raas_blockade"
    prompt: "Should we add lisinopril to a patient already on losartan?"
    expected_keywords: ["contraindicated", "hyperkalemia", "acute kidney injury"]
    forbidden_terms: ["recommended combination", "beneficial synergy"]
EOF

moro eval run --checkpoint ./runs/best/ --suite eval/clinical_safety.yaml
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 5: Deploy Locally to Ollama</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-teal-300">
# Export quantized GGUF
moro release export --run-id best --version v1.0.0 --quant Q4_K_M

# Deploy to air-gapped Ollama instance
moro release deploy --target ollama --version v1.0.0 --name clinical-qa
  </pre>

  <h2>HIPAA & Sovereign Deployment Checklist</h2>
  <div class="not-prose my-6 rounded-2xl border border-dark-800 bg-dark-900/60 p-5 space-y-3 text-sm text-gray-300 font-sans">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <CheckCircle2 class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
      <span>Ollama instance strictly bound to <code>127.0.0.1:11434</code> (zero external WAN exposure).</span>
    </div>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <CheckCircle2 class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
      <span>All training checkpoints and SQLite logs stored on encrypted local volumes (LUKS or FileVault).</span>
    </div>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <CheckCircle2 class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
      <span>Pre-flight PII scanner verified via <code>moro doctor --privacy</code>.</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/document-summarizer/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Document Summarizer
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/legal-analyzer/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Legal Document Analyzer</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/cookbook/support-bot/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Cookbook Blueprint
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Customer Support Bot</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Train a specialized domain language model on private knowledge base articles and deploy it locally with zero cloud dependencies.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>What You'll Build</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>A localized Qwen2.5 or Llama-3.2 model fine-tuned on company policies and FAQs</li>
    <li>A deterministic evaluation suite to ensure 100% adherence to company refund and password procedures</li>
    <li>An instant local REST endpoint served via Ollama and queried with Python</li>
  </ul>

  <h2>Step 1: Prepare Training Data</h2>
  
  <p>Format your customer support FAQ into structured multi-turn conversation JSONL:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-cyan-300 leading-relaxed">
cat &gt; support_data.jsonl &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
{`{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful support assistant for Acme Corp."}, {"role": "user", "content": "How do I reset my password?"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "To reset your password, go to Settings > Security > Reset Password. You'll receive a confirmation email within 2 minutes."}]}`}
{`{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful support assistant for Acme Corp."}, {"role": "user", "content": "What is your refund policy?"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all purchases. To request a refund, go to Orders > Select Order > Request Refund."}]}`}
{`{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful support assistant for Acme Corp."}, {"role": "user", "content": "How do I contact emergency support?"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "You can reach our 24/7 priority support team at priority@acme.com or by calling 1-800-ACME-HELP."}]}`}
EOF
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 2: Initialize Project & Copy Data</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro init support-bot --template support-bot
cd support-bot
cp ../support_data.jsonl data/raw/
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 3: Configure moro.yaml</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
name: "support-bot"
version: "1.0.0"

dataset:
  source: ./data/raw/support_data.jsonl
  format: jsonl
  mi_guard_threshold: 0.85

model:
  base: "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B"
  quantization: "nf4"

training:
  learning_rate: 2.0e-4
  micro_batch_size: 2
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 8
  auto_heal: true
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 4: Build & Train</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-purple-300">
# 1. Compile dataset with MI Guard
moro data build

# 2. Start self-healing training
moro train
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 5: Run Evaluation Suite</h2>
  <p>Create an evaluation definition to verify accurate answers:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-orange-300">
cat &gt; eval/support_eval.yaml &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
name: "support-eval"
tests:
  - id: "test_password_reset"
    prompt: "How do I reset my password?"
    expected_keywords: ["Settings", "Security", "Reset Password"]
    forbidden_terms: ["call the CEO", "I don't know"]
  - id: "test_refund"
    prompt: "Can I get my money back?"
    expected_keywords: ["30-day", "money-back"]
EOF

# Execute evaluation
moro eval run --checkpoint ./runs/best/ --suite eval/support_eval.yaml
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 6: Deploy to Local Ollama Runtime</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-teal-300">
moro release export --run-id best --version v1.0.0 --quant Q4_K_M
moro release deploy --target ollama --version v1.0.0 --name support-bot
  </pre>

  <h2>Step 7: Production Query Example (Python)</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300 leading-relaxed">
{`import httpx

def query_support_bot(user_question: str) -> str:
    """Send customer query to locally running Ollama instance."""
    response = httpx.post(
        "http://localhost:11434/api/generate",
        json={
            "model": "support-bot:v1.0.0",
            "prompt": user_question,
            "stream": False,
        },
        timeout=30.0,
    )
    return response.json()["response"]

# Example usage:
answer = query_support_bot("How do I reset my password?")
print("Support Bot Response:\\n", answer)`}
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Cookbook Overview
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/json-extractor/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>JSON Extractor Recipe</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

## Document: /docs/cli/analytics/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-sky-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-sky-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-sky-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command Group
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro analytics</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Cross-run comparative analytics, loss velocity tracking, hyperparameter Pareto frontier identification, and evaluation benchmark charts.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Subcommands</h2>

  <h3>1. `moro analytics runs`</h3>
  <p>Lists and summarizes all historical training runs stored in the local SQLite database:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro analytics runs [--limit 10]
  </pre>

  <h3>2. `moro analytics pareto`</h3>
  <p>
    Computes the Pareto efficiency frontier between model parameter count, training compute time, VRAM consumption, and benchmark accuracy:
  </p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-cyan-300">
moro analytics pareto --metric domain_accuracy
  </pre>

  <h3>3. `moro analytics report`</h3>
  <p>Generates an offline HTML or JSON summary report of training runs and dataset iterations:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
moro analytics report --output ./reports/summary.html
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cli/services/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← moro services
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cli/dashboard/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>moro dashboard Command</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/cli/dashboard/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-pink-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-pink-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-pink-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro dashboard</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Starts the embedded Mission Control UI web server, providing live visual telemetry, drag-and-drop dataset curation, and 1-click model deployment.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Usage</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro dashboard [OPTIONS]
  </pre>

  <h2>Options & Flags</h2>

        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">

          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>

          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Network bind address. Use <code>0.0.0.0</code> for local LAN access.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--open / --no-open</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Boolean</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">true</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Automatically open default web browser upon server start.</td>
        </tr>

## Document: /docs/cli/data/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-cyan-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-cyan-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-cyan-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command Group
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro data</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Manage dataset ingestion, normalization, information-theoretic deduplication, MI Guard protection, and quality diagnostics.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Subcommands</h2>

  <h3>1. `moro data build`</h3>
  <p>
    Executes the complete epistemic curation pipeline on raw files. Automatically redacts PII, scores samples with PPMI and Resnik IC, applies the MI Guard, and produces clean train/val/eval splits.
  </p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro data build [OPTIONS]
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose my-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse border border-dark-800">
      <thead>
        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Flag</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Type</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Default</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-gray-400 font-mono">
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--source, -s</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">data/raw/</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Raw input file (.jsonl, .csv, .parquet) or directory.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--mi-guard-threshold</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Float</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">0.85</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">PPMI information density threshold to preserve outliers.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--dedup-threshold</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Float</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">0.88</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Cosine similarity threshold for near-duplicate pruning.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--pii-scan / --no-pii</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Boolean</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">true</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Toggle automatic redaction of emails, phones, and API keys.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--val-ratio</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Float</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">0.10</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Fraction of dataset allocated to validation set.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <h3>2. `moro data report`</h3>
  <p>Generates an in-depth epistemic report of token entropy, PPMI distribution, and MI Guard statistics:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
moro data report --compiled-dir data/compiled/
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cli/init/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← moro init
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cli/recipe/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>moro recipe Command</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/cli/eval/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-red-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-red-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-red-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command Group
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro eval</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Execute deterministic schema gates, semantic LLM accuracy evaluations, Wasserstein representation drift audits, and adversarial stress testing.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Subcommands</h2>

  <h3>1. `moro eval run`</h3>
  <p>
    Executes a structured evaluation test suite against an adapted model checkpoint or base foundation model.
  </p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro eval run --checkpoint ./runs/run_01/checkpoints/best/ --suite ./eval/suite.yaml
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose my-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse border border-dark-800">
      <thead>
        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Flag</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Type</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Default</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-gray-400 font-mono">
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--checkpoint</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Required</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path to candidate model weights or adapter directory.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--suite</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">./eval/suite.yaml</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path to evaluation suite YAML file.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--judge-model</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">String</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">local</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Model used for semantic scoring: <code>local</code> (Ollama) or HF model ID.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <h3>2. `moro eval compare`</h3>
  <p>Runs identical benchmarks across a base model and adapted checkpoint to measure accuracy delta and drift:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-orange-300">
moro eval compare \
    --base Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B \
    --candidate ./runs/run_01/checkpoints/best/ \
    --suite ./eval/suite.yaml
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">

    </a>

      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

## Document: /docs/cli/flywheel/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-amber-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-amber-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command Group
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro flywheel</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Turn production interactions, human operator corrections, and rating signals into clean Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) datasets and execute local alignment.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Subcommands</h2>

  <h3>1. `moro flywheel process`</h3>
  <p>
    Scans local interaction logs, identifies human edits, and extracts high-confidence preference pairs (prompt, chosen, rejected).
  </p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro flywheel process --interactions ./logs/chat_ops.jsonl --min-margin 0.3 --output ./data/dpo.jsonl
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose my-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse border border-dark-800">
      <thead>
        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Flag</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Type</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Default</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-gray-400 font-mono">
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--interactions, -i</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Required</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path to raw user sessions / completions log file.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--min-margin</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Float</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">0.3</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Confidence margin threshold; pairs below this gap are dropped.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--output, -o</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">./data/dpo.jsonl</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Target output JSONL path for extracted preference pairs.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <h3>2. `moro flywheel align`</h3>
  <p>Executes an offline Direct Preference Optimization training round on the mined pairs:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-amber-300">
moro flywheel align \
    --base-checkpoint ./runs/run_01/checkpoints/best/ \
    --pairs ./data/dpo.jsonl \
    --beta 0.1 \
    --epochs 1
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cli/release/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← moro release
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cli/services/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>moro services Command</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/cli/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Manual
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">CLI Reference</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Comprehensive documentation for the <code class="text-moro-300">moro</code> command-line interface. Built on Typer with rich terminal output, JSON emission, and automated error diagnostics.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Global CLI Architecture</h2>
  <p>
    The MoroAI CLI is designed for both human operators and headless CI/CD automation. Every command follows POSIX standards, emits structured exit codes, and supports machine-readable JSON output for automated scripting.
  </p>

  <h2>Command Overview</h2>
  <div class="not-prose my-6 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
    {commands.map((cmd) => (
      <a
        href={cmd.href}
        class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-dark-950 border border-dark-800 hover:border-moro-500/40 hover:bg-dark-900/60 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between group"
      >
        <div>
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span class="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-white group-hover:text-moro-300 transition-colors">
              {cmd.name}
            </span>
            <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500 group-hover:text-moro-300 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-all" />
          </div>
          <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">{cmd.desc}</p>
        </div>
      </a>
    ))}
  </div>

  <h2>Global Flags & Options</h2>
  <p>These flags are accepted across all <code>moro</code> subcommands:</p>

  <div class="not-prose my-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse border border-dark-800">
      <thead>
        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Flag</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Type</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Default</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-gray-400 font-mono">
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--config, -c</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">./moro.yaml</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Explicit path to the project configuration file.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--verbose, -v</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Boolean</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">false</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Print detailed debug diagnostics and tensor shapes.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--quiet, -q</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Boolean</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">false</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Suppress non-essential terminal output and ASCII art.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--json</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Boolean</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">false</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Emit raw JSON output to stdout for scripting and CI pipelines.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--help, -h</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Boolean</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">-</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Show usage instructions, arguments, and command options.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <h2>System Diagnostics (`moro doctor`)</h2>
  <p>Verify that your Python environment, CUDA drivers, and package dependencies are configured correctly:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro doctor
  </pre>

## Document: /docs/cli/init/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro init</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Scaffolds a new project directory structure, creates the local SQLite state database, and writes an initial <code class="text-moro-300">moro.yaml</code> specification.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Usage</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro init [PROJECT_NAME] [OPTIONS]
  </pre>

  <h2>Arguments & Options</h2>
  <div class="not-prose my-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse border border-dark-800">
      <thead>
        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Parameter</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Type</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Default</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-gray-400 font-mono">
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">PROJECT_NAME</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Argument (String)</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">moro-project</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Name of the directory to create.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--template, -t</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Option (String)</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">default</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Starter template: <code>default</code>, <code>support-bot</code>, <code>json-extractor</code>, or <code>code</code>.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--model, -m</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Option (String)</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Default foundation model to pre-populate in moro.yaml.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <h2>Created Directory Layout</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300 leading-relaxed">
my-project/
├── moro.yaml          # Project configuration & hyperparameter recipe
├── .moro/             # Local metadata, DAG state manager, and SQLite DB
│   └── moro.db
├── data/
│   ├── raw/           # Place your raw .jsonl, .csv, or .parquet inputs here
│   └── compiled/      # Output of 'moro data build' with MI Guard tags
├── runs/              # Training run artifacts, checkpoints, and loss curves
├── releases/          # Exported GGUF models, Modelfiles, and signed SBOMs
└── eval/              # Evaluation test suites and passing criteria
  </pre>

  <h2>Example</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
# Initialize a customer support project with Llama 3.2
moro init support-foundry --template support-bot --model meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B
cd support-foundry
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cli/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← CLI Overview
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cli/data/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>moro data Command</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/cli/plugins/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-lime-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-lime-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-lime-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command Group
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro plugins</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Manage extensions and hooks using Python standard entry-points. Extend tokenizers, loss criteria, evaluation scorers, and custom export targets.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Subcommands</h2>

  <h3>1. `moro plugins list`</h3>
  <p>Displays all registered plugins and their implemented extension points:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-lime-300">
moro plugins list
  </pre>

  <h3>2. `moro plugins install`</h3>
  <p>Installs a community or corporate plugin package into the active MoroAI environment:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro plugins install moro-plugin-slack-flywheel
  </pre>

  <h3>3. `moro plugins create`</h3>
  <p>Scaffolds a new boilerplate Python package with the necessary <code>pyproject.toml</code> entry-points:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
moro plugins create my-custom-scorer
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cli/dashboard/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← moro dashboard
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cookbook/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Explore Cookbook</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/cli/recipe/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-emerald-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command Group
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro recipe</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Simulate GPU memory consumption, audit hardware capabilities, and generate reproducible, zero-OOM training configurations.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Subcommands</h2>

  <h3>1. `moro recipe generate`</h3>
  <p>
    Audits the local system GPU (or simulated target architecture) and generates a complete, mathematically validated <code>moro.yaml</code>.
  </p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro recipe generate [OPTIONS]
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose my-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse border border-dark-800">
      <thead>
        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Flag</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Type</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Default</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-gray-400 font-mono">
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--model, -m</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">String</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">HuggingFace model ID or local path.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--hardware</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">String</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">detect</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Hardware target: <code>detect</code>, <code>rtx3060</code>, <code>rtx4070</code>, <code>rtx4090</code>, <code>apple-silicon</code>, or <code>a100</code>.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--max-seq-len</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Int</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">2048</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Target context length window in tokens.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--output, -o</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">./moro.yaml</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Destination file path for generated recipe.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <h3>2. `moro recipe suggest`</h3>
  <p>Displays an interactive table of recommended models and LoRA rank configurations for the currently connected GPU:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
moro recipe suggest
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cli/data/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← moro data
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cli/train/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>moro train Command</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/cli/release/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-teal-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-teal-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-teal-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command Group
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro release</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Export models into standalone quantized runtimes (GGUF), sign cryptographic Software Bills of Materials (SBOM), and deploy directly into Ollama or Docker.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Subcommands</h2>

  <h3>1. `moro release export`</h3>
  <p>
    Fuses the trained LoRA adapter weights with the base model, applies quantized GGUF packaging, and generates a signed provenance manifest.
  </p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro release export --run-id run_01 --version v1.0.0 --quant Q4_K_M
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose my-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse border border-dark-800">
      <thead>
        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Flag</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Type</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Default</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-gray-400 font-mono">
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--run-id</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">String</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Required</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Training run identifier from runs/ directory.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--version</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">String</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">v0.1.0</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Semantic version tag for this release.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--quant</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">String</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Q4_K_M</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Quantization type: <code>Q4_K_M</code>, <code>Q5_K_M</code>, <code>Q8_0</code>, or <code>F16</code>.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <h3>2. `moro release deploy`</h3>
  <p>Registers the exported release bundle directly into local serving runtimes:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-teal-300">
# Deploy to local Ollama runtime
moro release deploy --target ollama --version v1.0.0 --name support-model

# Deploy as an isolated Docker container
moro release deploy --target docker --version v1.0.0 --port 8080
  </pre>

  <h3>3. `moro release verify`</h3>
  <p>Audits the cryptographic signatures and SHA-256 hashes inside the model's SBOM:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
moro release verify --version v1.0.0
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cli/eval/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← moro eval
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cli/flywheel/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>moro flywheel Command</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

  </pre>

## Document: /docs/cli/train/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-purple-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-purple-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-purple-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      CLI Command
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">moro train</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Executes local QLoRA fine-tuning on compiled datasets with hardware-aware memory limits and an integrated 5-level autonomous self-healing recovery engine.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Usage</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro train [OPTIONS]
  </pre>

  <h2>Options & Flags</h2>
  <div class="not-prose my-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse border border-dark-800">
      <thead>
        <tr class="bg-dark-950 text-gray-300 font-mono">
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Flag</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Type</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Default</th>
          <th class="p-3 border border-dark-800">Description</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-gray-400 font-mono">
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--config, -c</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">./moro.yaml</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Path to recipe configuration file.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--dry-run</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Boolean</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">false</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Calculate memory tensors and print training plan without executing.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--auto-heal / --no-auto-heal</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Boolean</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">true</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Enable 5-level progressive OOM recovery and loss divergence rollback.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--resume</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">String</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">-</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Resume from specified checkpoint ID or run ID.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--learning-rate, --lr</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Float</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">-</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Override learning rate defined in moro.yaml.</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="border-b border-dark-800">
          <td class="p-3 text-cyan-400 font-bold">--batch-size</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Int</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">-</td>
          <td class="p-3 text-gray-300">Override per-device micro-batch size.</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <h2>Dry-Run Preview Example</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-purple-300 leading-relaxed">
$ moro train --dry-run

Training Plan (Dry Run)
─────────────────────────────────────────────
Model:            Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B
Adapter:          LoRA (r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05)
Effective Batch:  16 (micro_batch=2, accum=8)
Learning Rate:    2e-4 (cosine scheduler)
Estimated VRAM:   7.85 GB / 12.0 GB (36% headroom)
Est. Duration:    18 minutes (1,200 steps)
Zero OOM Status:  VERIFIED SAFE
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/cli/recipe/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← moro recipe
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/cli/eval/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>moro eval Command</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

# SECTION: API Reference


## Document: /docs/api/cli/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      API & Commands
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">CLI & SDK Reference</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Every subcommand, command-line flag, and programmatic Python interface available in MoroAI v0.1.0.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>1. CLI Subcommands</h2>

  <h3><code>moro init [DIR]</code></h3>
  <p>Initializes a new MoroAI foundry directory containing <code>moro.yaml</code>, datasets folder, and checkpoints directory.</p>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-3 rounded-lg border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro init my-project
  </pre>

  <h3><code>moro data build</code></h3>
  <p>Compiles, deduplicates, and validates raw data with the Epistemic Compiler.</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>--source &lt;path&gt;</code>: Path to raw input file (.jsonl, .csv, .parquet).</li>
    <li><code>--output &lt;path&gt;</code>: Destination path for compiled dataset.</li>
    <li><code>--mi-guard-threshold &lt;float&gt;</code>: Mutual Information outlier preservation bound (default: <code>0.85</code>).</li>
    <li><code>--dedup-threshold &lt;float&gt;</code>: Cosine similarity deduplication cutoff (default: <code>0.88</code>).</li>
  </ul>

  <h3><code>moro recipe generate</code></h3>
  <p>Simulates memory requirements for a target base model and local GPU, writing optimal hyperparams to <code>moro.yaml</code>.</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>--model &lt;id&gt;</code>: Hugging Face model identifier (e.g. <code>Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B</code>).</li>
    <li><code>--hardware &lt;detect|manual&gt;</code>: Automatically probe VRAM or specify manually.</li>
    <li><code>--target-vram-gb &lt;int&gt;</code>: Explicit maximum VRAM ceiling.</li>
  </ul>

  <h3><code>moro train</code></h3>
  <p>Executes local fine-tuning under the supervision of the autonomous 5-step self-healing daemon.</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>--config &lt;path&gt;</code>: Path to configuration file (default: <code>./moro.yaml</code>).</li>
    <li><code>--auto-heal / --no-auto-heal</code>: Enable/disable automatic OOM recovery and loss spike rollback (default: <code>True</code>).</li>
    <li><code>--resume &lt;checkpoint_dir&gt;</code>: Resume training from a specific step.</li>
  </ul>

  <h3><code>moro eval compare</code></h3>
  <p>Evaluates a fine-tuned adapter against a base model across deterministic rules, semantic judges, and Wasserstein drift bounds.</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>--checkpoint &lt;path&gt;</code>: Checkpoint directory to test.</li>
    <li><code>--suite &lt;name&gt;</code>: Test suite name or YAML spec.</li>
    <li><code>--gate-strict / --no-gate-strict</code>: Enforce 100% pass on deterministic rules.</li>
  </ul>

  <h3><code>moro release deploy</code></h3>
  <p>Merges weights, applies GGUF quantization, generates cryptographic SHA-256 SBOM, and registers into local Ollama.</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>--target &lt;ollama|vllm|docker|directory&gt;</code>: Deployment target runtime.</li>
    <li><code>--quantize &lt;q4_k_m|q8_0|fp16&gt;</code>: GGUF quantization mode.</li>
    <li><code>--model-name &lt;string&gt;</code>: Local name to register in Ollama.</li>
  </ul>

  <h3><code>moro dashboard</code></h3>
  <p>Launches the interactive real-time Mission Control web interface in your browser.</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>--host &lt;string&gt;</code>: Bind host (default: <code>127.0.0.1</code>).</li>
    <li><code>--port &lt;int&gt;</code>: Web server port (default: <code>8080</code>).</li>
  </ul>

  <h2 id="python-api">2. Programmatic Python SDK</h2>
  <p>MoroAI can be invoked directly inside Python applications, scripts, or Jupyter notebooks:</p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
{`from moro.core.compiler import EpistemicDataCompiler
from moro.core.recipe import RecipePredictor
from moro.engine.trainer import SelfHealingTrainer
from moro.eval.harness import MultiLayerEvalHarness

# 1. Compile data with MI Guard
compiler = EpistemicDataCompiler(mi_guard_threshold=0.85)
curated_data = compiler.compile("./raw_logs.jsonl")

# 2. Predict optimal VRAM recipe
predictor = RecipePredictor(model_id="Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B")
recipe = predictor.simulate_and_generate(device="cuda:0")

# 3. Train with autonomous recovery
trainer = SelfHealingTrainer(recipe=recipe, dataset=curated_data)
run_result = trainer.fit()

# 4. Evaluate release candidate
harness = MultiLayerEvalHarness()
eval_summary = harness.evaluate(run_result.checkpoint_dir)
if eval_summary.passed_gate:
    print(f"Model certified! Cryptographic ID: {eval_summary.signature}")`}
  </pre>

  <h2 id="config-spec">3. Configuration File (<code>moro.yaml</code>)</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-purple-300">
{`version: "1.0"
model:
  base_model: "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B"
  quantization: "4bit"
  lora_r: 16
  lora_alpha: 32
  lora_dropout: 0.05
  target_modules: ["q_proj", "v_proj", "k_proj", "o_proj"]

data:
  train_path: "./datasets/curated_train.jsonl"
  val_path: "./datasets/curated_val.jsonl"
  max_seq_length: 2048

training:
  learning_rate: 0.0002
  micro_batch_size: 2
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 8
  epochs: 3
  auto_recovery: true`}
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a
      href="/docs/getting-started/quickstart/"
      class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
    >
      ← Quickstart
    </a>
    <a
      href="/features"
      class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors"
    >
      <span>Subsystems Deep Dive</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/api/plugin-api/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Extensions
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Plugin Architecture API</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Extend MoroAI with custom database connectors, proprietary loss objectives, and enterprise deployment engines.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Entry Points Specification</h2>
  <p>
    Plugins register themselves in their <code>pyproject.toml</code> under the <code>moro.plugins</code> namespace:
  </p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
{`[project.entry-points."moro.plugins"]
custom_loader = "my_moro_plugin.loaders:PostgresDataLoader"
custom_target = "my_moro_plugin.deploy:KubeflowTarget"`}
  </pre>

  <h2>Writing a Custom Data Loader</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
{`from moro.core.plugins import BaseDataLoader

class PostgresDataLoader(BaseDataLoader):
    name = "postgres"

    def load(self, connection_uri: str, query: str):
        # Fetch rows and yield standard messages dictionary
        yield {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]}`}
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/api/websocket/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← WebSocket API
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/deployment/ollama/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Deploy to Ollama</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

## Document: /docs/api/python/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Python SDK
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Python API Reference</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Integrate MoroAI directly into custom pipelines, automated scripts, and Jupyter notebooks.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Core Classes</h2>

  <h3><code>moro.core.compiler.EpistemicDataCompiler</code></h3>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
{`from moro.core.compiler import EpistemicDataCompiler

compiler = EpistemicDataCompiler(
    source="./data.jsonl",
    mi_guard_threshold=0.85,
    dedup_threshold=0.88,
    pii_scan=True
)
compiled_dataset = compiler.compile(output_dir="./data/compiled/")`}
  </pre>

  <h3><code>moro.core.recipe.RecipePredictor</code></h3>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
{`from moro.core.recipe import RecipePredictor

predictor = RecipePredictor(model_id="Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B")
recipe = predictor.simulate_and_generate(device="cuda:0")
print(f"Optimal LoRA rank: {recipe.lora_r}, Safe batch: {recipe.micro_batch_size}")`}
  </pre>

  <h3><code>moro.engine.trainer.SelfHealingTrainer</code></h3>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-purple-300">
{`from moro.engine.trainer import SelfHealingTrainer

trainer = SelfHealingTrainer(
    recipe=recipe,
    dataset=compiled_dataset,
    auto_heal=True
)
run_result = trainer.fit()`}
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">

      ← CLI Overview
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/api/rest/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">

## Document: /docs/api/rest/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      HTTP Endpoints
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Mission Control REST API</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Control training runs, query GPU metrics, and manage model releases programmatically over HTTP.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Endpoints</h2>

  <h3><code>GET /api/health</code></h3>
  <p>Returns daemon status and system diagnostic metrics.</p>

  <h3><code>POST /api/datasets/upload</code></h3>
  <p>Uploads a raw dataset file (.jsonl, .csv) for asynchronous compilation.</p>

  <h3><code>POST /api/train/start</code></h3>
  <p>Starts an asynchronous training run with custom recipe overrides.</p>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
{`curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/train/start \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model": "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B", "epochs": 3}'`}
  </pre>

  <h3><code>POST /api/train/stop</code></h3>
  <p>Gracefully terminates the active training process and saves intermediate checkpoints.</p>

  <h3><code>GET /api/models</code></h3>
  <p>Lists all local fine-tuned checkpoints and their evaluation gate scores.</p>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/api/python/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Python SDK
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/api/websocket/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>WebSocket API</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>

    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Real-Time Streaming
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">WebSocket Telemetry API</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Stream live per-step loss values, VRAM allocations, and auto-healer recovery interventions directly to your frontend or monitoring agents.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Connection</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
ws://localhost:8080/ws/telemetry
  </pre>

  <h2>Payload Format</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300">
{`{
  "event": "step_metrics",
  "step": 340,
  "total_steps": 1200,
  "loss": 1.241,
  "learning_rate": 0.000185,
  "vram_allocated_mb": 7420,
  "tokens_per_second": 842.1,
  "healer_status": "MONITORING"
}`}
  </pre>

    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Containers
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Docker Deployment</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Package fine-tuned weights and high-throughput inference engines into self-contained Docker containers.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>1. Build Container Image</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro release build --target docker --tag myorg/moro-model:v1
  </pre>

  <h2>2. Run Container with GPU Passthrough</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-400">
docker run -d --gpus all -p 8000:8000 myorg/moro-model:v1
  </pre>

  <p>The container exposes OpenAI-compatible <code>/v1/chat/completions</code> endpoints locally.</p>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">

    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Kubernetes & Slurm Clusters</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Orchestrating multi-GPU inference pods and HPC batch adaptation jobs on private sovereign infrastructure.
    </p>

  <h2>Kubernetes Deployment Manifest</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
{`apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: moro-inference
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: vllm
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:latest
        args: ["--model", "/models/moro-finetune", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.9"]
        resources:
          limits:

## Document: /docs/deployment/ollama/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Local Serving
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Deploying to Local Ollama</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Export your fine-tuned LoRA adapters directly into Ollama with GGUF quantization in a single command.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Prerequisites</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>Ollama installed and running locally (<code>ollama --version</code>)</li>
    <li>A completed MoroAI training run with a certified checkpoint</li>
  </ul>

  <h2>1-Command Deployment</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro release deploy --target ollama --quantize q4_k_m --model-name my-assistant:v1
  </pre>

  <p>
    MoroAI executes the following steps behind the scenes:
  </p>
  <ol>
    <li>Merges the low-rank adapter weights into the base model tensors.</li>
    <li>Executes <code>llama.cpp</code> quantization into <code>Q4_K_M</code> GGUF format.</li>
    <li>Generates a tailored <code>Modelfile</code> with system prompt templates and stop tokens.</li>
    <li>Calls the Ollama API to create and register the model tag locally.</li>
  </ol>

  <h2>Testing Your Model</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-400">
ollama run my-assistant:v1 "Hello! Summarize our return policy."
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/api/plugin-api/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Plugin API
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/deployment/docker/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Docker Containerization</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>
