## Document: /docs/deployment/production/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Production Checklist
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Production Best Practices</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Operational standards for reliability, low-latency inference, and continuous drift monitoring.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>1. Quantization Selection</h2>
  <p>
    For consumer GPU inference, choose <code>Q4_K_M</code> for a near-lossless balance of precision and speed. For high-precision coding and mathematical reasoning, deploy <code>Q8_0</code> or FP16.
  </p>

  <h2>2. Automated Release Gate Enforcement</h2>
  <p>
    Never deploy an untested adapter directly into production. Enforce <code>moro eval compare --gate-strict</code> in CI before allowing promotion into production registries.
  </p>

  <h2>3. Continuous Lineage Backup</h2>
  <p>
    Archive <code>.moro/state.db</code> and release manifests alongside model weights to maintain verifiable regulatory compliance.
  </p>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">

      ← Kubernetes & Slurm
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/guides/troubleshooting/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Troubleshooting Guide</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>

      Open Source
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Contributing to MoroAI</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Guidelines for submitting bug reports, writing test cases, and opening pull requests.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>Setting Up Local Development</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/MoroAI/moro.git
cd moro

# Install in editable mode with development extras
pip install -e '.[dev,train]'
  </pre>

  <h2>Running the Test Suite</h2>
  <p>All PRs must maintain 100% pass rates across the test suite:</p>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-400">
pytest
  </pre>

  <h2>Code Standards</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>Format code with <code>ruff</code> and <code>black</code>.</li>
    <li>Ensure all CLI arguments include descriptive help text.</li>
    <li>Include unit tests under <code>tests/</code> for all new functions.</li>
  </ul>

## Document: /docs/guides/performance/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Hardware Optimization
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Consumer GPU Performance Tuning</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Techniques to maximize tokens/second and train 1.5B–14B models on consumer graphics cards.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>1. Flash Attention 2 & SDPA</h2>
  <p>
    Ensure PyTorch 2.0+ uses scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) or Flash Attention 2 for 2.5x speedups and 50% activation memory reduction.
  </p>

  <h2>2. 8-Bit AdamW Optimizer</h2>
  <p>
    Using <code>paged_adamw_8bit</code> cuts optimizer state memory footprint by 75% compared to standard FP32 AdamW without any drop in model quality.
  </p>

  <h2>3. LoRA Rank & Target Modules</h2>
  <p>
    Setting <code>lora_r=16</code> with <code>lora_alpha=32</code> provides 98% of the expressive power of full fine-tuning with only 0.2% of the trainable parameters.
  </p>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/guides/troubleshooting/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Troubleshooting
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/guides/privacy/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Air-Gapped Privacy</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>

## Document: /docs/guides/privacy/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Security & Sovereignty
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Air-Gapped & Sovereign Privacy</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Architectural guarantees ensuring zero telemetry leakage and complete data sovereignty.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>1. Zero Cloud Telemetry</h2>
  <p>
    MoroAI does not phone home. No usage stats, prompts, weights, or logs are transmitted to external servers. You can run MoroAI completely disconnected from the public internet.
  </p>

  <h2>2. Built-in PII Redaction Filter</h2>
  <p>
    The Epistemic Compiler includes an automated PII detector that flags social security numbers, credit cards, emails, and phone numbers before training begins:
  </p>

  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro data build --source ./raw.jsonl --pii-scan --redact-pii
  </pre>

  <h2>3. Cryptographic Verification</h2>
  <p>
    All datasets and model checkpoints are hashed with SHA-256 for internal compliance audits under ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.
  </p>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/guides/performance/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Performance Tuning
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/guides/contributing/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Contributing Guide</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>

## Document: /docs/guides/troubleshooting/

<div class="not-prose mb-8">
    <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-moro-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-moro-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-moro-500/20 mb-3 inline-block">
      Diagnostics
    </span>
    <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Troubleshooting & Diagnostics</h1>
    <p class="text-gray-400 text-base mt-2">
      Quickly resolve common CUDA allocator errors, driver incompatibilities, and dataset format warnings.
    </p>
  </div>

  <h2>1. Run System Health Check</h2>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-sky-300">
moro doctor
  </pre>

  <h2>2. CUDA Out Of Memory (OOM) Errors</h2>
  <p>
    If training experiences memory pressure despite auto-recovery, adjust your configuration:
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li>Enable gradient checkpointing: <code>gradient_checkpointing: true</code> in <code>moro.yaml</code>.</li>
    <li>Reduce micro-batch size to 1 and double gradient accumulation: <code>micro_batch_size: 1</code>.</li>
    <li>Clamp sequence length: <code>max_seq_length: 1024</code>.</li>
  </ul>

  <h2>3. MPS Accelerator (Apple Silicon)</h2>
  <p>
    On Apple Silicon M-series Macs, ensure PyTorch uses MPS:
  </p>
  <pre class="bg-dark-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dark-800 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-400">
export PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1
moro diagnose
  </pre>

  <div class="not-prose mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-dark-800 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="/docs/deployment/production/" class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
      ← Production Best Practices
    </a>
    <a href="/docs/guides/performance/" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-moro-500 hover:bg-moro-400 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors">
      <span>Performance Tuning</span>
      <ArrowRight class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
    </a>
  </div>
